relations.text: ウォーバーグ・ピンカスなどと2023年9月に立ち上げた再保険会社である
relations.text_en: A reinsurer launched in September 2023 together with Warburg Pincus and a group of institutional investors

source.quote: In September 2023, we, together with Warburg Pincus and a group of institutional investors, launched Prismic Life Reinsurance, Ltd.

companies.name: ウィルトン・リアシュアランス

relations.text: 2024年8月に保証付き ユニバーサル生命保険の再保険契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered into an agreement in August 2024 to reinsure certain guaranteed universal life policies

source.label: Prudential Financial 10-K(2025)
source.quote: In August 2024, the Company entered into an agreement with Wilton Reassurance Company and Wilton Reinsurance Bermuda Limited (collectively, “Wilton Re”) to reinsure certain guaranteed universal life policies

companies.name: サマセット・リインシュアランス

relations.text: 2024年第1四半期に再保険取引を完了した
relations.text_en: Closed a reinsurance transaction in the first quarter of 2024

source.label: Prudential Financial 10-K(2025)
source.quote: following the close of the reinsurance transaction with Somerset Reinsurance Ltd. (“Somerset Re”) in the first quarter of 2024.

relations.text: 2013年に個人生命保険事業を買収した相手である
relations.text_en: Prudential acquired its individual life insurance business in 2013

source.label: Prudential Financial 10-K(2025)
source.quote: We also use assumed reinsurance in connection with our 2013 acquisition of The Hartford’s individual life insurance business.

relations.text: 2006年に変額年金事業を買収した相手である
